name: veterinary_clinic_system_057_unlinked_lab_orphans
instruction: Data hygiene: every lab_results row must reference a patient that exists AND is not status 'transferred' (transferred patients' results belong to the receiving clinic). Find orphan rows (patient_id missing from patients, or pointing at a transferred patient) and mark them orphan=true with orphan_note='<batch_code>'. Do not delete anything; do not modify valid rows.
